en: The image shows a black-and-white or sepia-toned panoramic view of a small European town set against a hillside or low mountain. The town consists of traditional houses with gabled roofs, a few larger buildings, and is surrounded by trees and cultivated fields. The prominent hill in the background appears to be a natural landmark. The text below the image reads 'Bilin. Clumberg.', and in the lower left, there is a publisher's mark: 'Brück & Sohn, Meissen.'
